description: This file defines structures and APIs for handling HTTP headers, including functions for creating, manipulating, querying, and tokenizing HTTP header entries.

classes.name: liHttpHeader
classes.description: Represents an individual HTTP header with key length and data string.

classes.name: liHttpHeaders
classes.description: A collection of HTTP headers, implemented as a queue.

classes.name: liHttpHeaderTokenizer
classes.description: A simple tokenizer for parsing HTTP header fields.

methods.name: li_http_headers_new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of liHttpHeaders.

methods.name: li_http_headers_reset
methods.description: Resets the header collection to an empty state.

methods.name: li_http_headers_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with the header collection.

methods.name: li_http_header_append
methods.description: Appends a value to an existing header or adds a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: li_http_header_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new header with specified key and value.

methods.name: li_http_header_overwrite
methods.description: Overwrites the value of an existing header or inserts a new one.

methods.name: li_http_header_remove
methods.description: Removes all headers with the specified key.

methods.name: li_http_header_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a header by key.

methods.name: li_http_header_find_first
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a header with specified key.

methods.name: li_http_header_find_next
methods.description: Finds the next header with specified key after a given list element.

methods.name: li_http_header_find_last
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a header with specified key.

methods.name: li_http_header_is
methods.description: Checks if headers contain a specific key-value pair.

methods.name: li_http_header_get_all
methods.description: Concatenates all headers with the specified key into a string.

methods.name: li_http_header_tokenizer_start
methods.description: Initializes the tokenizer for a specific header key.

methods.name: li_http_header_tokenizer_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next token from the tokenizer.

methods.name: INLINE gboolean li_http_header_key_is(liHttpHeader * h,const gchar * key,size_t keylen)

ctags.name: keylen
ctags.pattern: /^	guint keylen;     \/** length of "headername" in data *\/$/

ctags.name: li_http_header_key_is
ctags.pattern: /^INLINE gboolean li_http_header_key_is(liHttpHeader *h, const gchar *key, size_t keylen) {$/
